title: Charting Neverland
tagline: A sketch, a scale, and a walk a human can actually take
description: Peter flies but you walk, so you must chart an island from Barrie's sketch. A navigation adventure through scale, latitude, compass, speed as a ratio, and a plan that still fits daylight.
worldPrompt: An original mapmaker's adventure after J. M. Barrie's Peter Pan (1911, public domain). The learner is the mapkeeper of the nursery party: Wendy, John, Michael, and the lost boys following Peter's sketch. Each chapter gates the geography and ratio unit: scale and ground distance, latitude as a sideways line, compass rose and direction, speed as distance over time, combining scale and speed into a walk plan, and a chart a sailor would trust. Characters are Barrie's nursery party only. Tone is crisp and serious about accuracy, playful only about Neverland's impossibilities. Loot is navigation gear: scale ruler, latitude string, compass rose, sand timer.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.bio: The mapkeeper who measures along curves and writes the ratio so another person could check it.

characters.name: John
characters.bio: Loves hats and latitudes. He holds the sideways string at the right degree.

characters.name: Michael
characters.bio: Small, keen, and trusted with the scale. You walk in his careful shoes.

characters.name: Peter Pan
characters.bio: Brilliant at flying, bad at counting. His about is always braver than the ground allows.

chapters.title: How Big on Paper?
chapters.hook: One centimetre on the sketch stands for some kilometres on the island.

chapters.title: How Far North?
chapters.hook: Sideways lines that tell the equator how far away you are.

chapters.title: Which Way Is Southeast?
chapters.hook: Between south and east lies the hill. Check the rose, not your guess.

chapters.title: How Fast? How Long?
chapters.hook: Time equals distance over speed. The hill will be slower than the beach.

chapters.title: A Walk That Fits Daylight
chapters.hook: Scale then speed, then ask whether the hours fit the afternoon.

loot.name: Scale Ruler
loot.description: Wendy's ruler: map centimetres times km per centimetre equals ground. Chapter 1, the sketch.

loot.name: Latitude String
loot.description: John's sideways string held at 10 N while sailing west: latitude stays, longitude changes. Chapter 2, at sea.

loot.name: Compass Rose
loot.description: The rose that puts north at the top unless an arrow says otherwise, between south and east lies southeast. Chapter 3, direction.

loot.name: Sand Timer
loot.description: The glass that measures hours against km per hour. Distance divided by speed, daylight left over. Chapter 4, speed.

loot.name: Chartmaster's Seal
loot.description: Wendy's seal when scale, latitude, rose, and hours all check and the walk fits daylight. Legendary navigation clear.
